remaining.title: Dates and a per-expense note
remaining.why: Listed under mostWantedNext, not in the ordered fixes array. It needs a new field on the expense record, a date control, sorting, and print/CSV columns — product work rather than a defect fix, and a half-version would spend the remaining budget without closing a finding. The 'what for' complaint is partly answered: reasonLine() now carries the expense labels into the Venmo note, the copied summary and the CSV.

remaining.title: Persisting the settle-up view choice
remaining.why: settleView is a module variable, so 'Pay who you owe' resets to 'Fewest payments' on reload. Putting it in state would change the shared codec and sanitizeState for a display preference, widening the share payload every user carries in their address bar.
